blockers: At native 192px presentation, the character collapses into a narrow dark armored column; the intended corset, high collar, brass trim, and rapier are not reliably readable.
The signature gesture strip does not communicate a distinct gesture. Most frames are nearly identical, with only minor arm displacement and no clear anticipation, accent, or posed endpoint.
The face reads as a featureless helmet or robot visor rather than a deliberately structured character face. The tiny red eye marks are isolated pixels and create an uncanny mask effect.
The rapier is inconsistently visible and frequently merges with the leg or background. Its profile, hilt, and blade need a stronger readable rhythm.
The navy-on-obsidian value grouping is too compressed. Large torso, skirt, and limb masses merge, undermining material separation and silhouette parsing.

The locomotion set has limited directional personality: several diagonals and side views appear to reuse the same rigid torso and arm relationship instead of expressing controlled, deliberate movement.
The sprite does not yet meet professional readability standards at the required gameplay scale despite passing height and anchor validation.
high_value_changes: Redesign the silhouette around three unmistakable shape groups: high collar and head, tapered corset torso, and separated split-leg/skirt forms. Preserve visible negative space between arms, torso, thighs, and weapon.
Raise the value separation between obsidian, midnight navy, skin or glove highlights, and brass. Reserve the brightest highlights for collar edges, corset structure, hands, and rapier hardware.
Give the rapier a consistent contrasting edge and a clearly separated hilt. Maintain its screen-space direction across all eight directional families.

Rebuild the face as a few intentional, readable planes: head contour, visor or eyes, lower-face shadow, and one controlled highlight. Remove isolated red pixels unless they form a coherent facial feature.

Reanimate the gesture with a readable preparation phase, a strong restrained extension, a brief overshoot, and a settle. The pose should read when frames are viewed as thumbnails, not only in sequence.
Introduce controlled asymmetry in idle and locomotion: slight shoulder offset, weapon-side bias, and differentiated leg compression while keeping the ground anchor fixed.
Audit all frames at native scale and make pixel clusters deliberate. The current smooth, glossy rendering produces soft blobs where hard retro-anachronistic shape breaks are needed.
optional_notes: The reported 119.7px standing height and zero ground-anchor drift are correct and should be preserved during visual revisions.
The silhouette mask shows a recognizable tall, narrow figure, but recognition depends too heavily on the overall vertical outline rather than character-specific costume features.
The 4x nearest-neighbor enlargement exposes broad blurry-looking highlight bands and weak pixel-cluster design; do not judge the enlarged sheet as proof of native readability.
The front view is more legible than the side and diagonal views, but it still reads closer to a generic armored automaton than a restrained rapier-wielding woman.
regressions_from_previous: No prior-round visual sheet was supplied, so specific round-to-round regressions cannot be verified.

The current package nevertheless contains an unresolved identity regression risk: technical compliance is strong, but costume, facial, weapon, and gesture cues remain less readable than the archetype specification requires.
strongest_improvements: Standing height is within the 128px contract.
Ground anchoring is stable with 0px reported drift.
The character maintains a consistent tall, contained vertical proportion across the directional grid.
The palette establishes a coherent midnight navy and brass direction, even though its internal value separation is insufficient.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the native-scale silhouette and value grouping so the high collar, corset, separated lower-body forms, hands, and rapier read as distinct shapes before adding any further animation polish.
